title: Shimmering half-life decay indicators and disintegration particle motes on whichever sigil is queued to vanish next under Ephemeral Protocol.
summary: Render dynamic decay shimmer and continuous disintegration motes on each contender's impending oldest sigil.
technical_specification: When `state.stats.ephemeralProtocol` is true and `queue.length === 3`, identify target sector `idx = queue[0]`. Compute half-life pulsing factor `alpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(state.world.time * 6)`. Render a caustic border stroke with `ctx.strokeStyle = factionColor` at `alpha * 0.8` and radial jitter `dr = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2`. Spawn persistent dissipation motes into `state.world.particles` at sector center `(cx, cy)`: velocity `vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 28`, `vy = -Math.random() * 35 - 10`, lifetime `0.6s`, fading stroke alpha. On `EPHEMERAL_EVICT`, spawn a 24-mote radial burst.
acceptance_criteria: Oldest sigil displays pulsating chromatic shimmer only when queue reaches capacity 3.
Disintegration motes float upward continuously from the queued eviction sector.
EPHEMERAL_EVICT triggers a tactile dissipation particle burst across the freed sector.
